```{r setup, include = FALSE}
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr) # for mutate

dt_csp <- params$dt_csp
```

---

# Summary

## General Information

```{r summary_general_info, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
df1 <- data.frame(a = c("Case Name", "User", "Date", "KongohPlus version"), 
                  b = c("251006_test", "Sho Manabe", "2025-10-06", "0.21.6"))

df1_short <- df1 %>%
  mutate(b_display = ifelse(nchar(b) > 25, 
                            paste0(substr(b, 1, 10), "...", substr(b, nchar(b) - 9, nchar(b))),
                            b)) %>%
  dplyr::select(a, b = b_display)

k1 <- kable(df1_short, "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL,
            escape = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped"), full_width = TRUE)

k1
```

## Files

```{r summary_file_info, echo = FALSE, results='asis'}
df2 <- data.frame(a = c("Crime Stain Profile", "Reference Profile", "Allele frequency"), 
                  b = c("cccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccccc_aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa.csv", "rrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr.csv", "af.csv"))

df2_short <- df2 %>%
  mutate(b_display = ifelse(nchar(b) > 25, 
                            paste0(substr(b, 1, 10), "...", substr(b, nchar(b) - 9, nchar(b))),
                            b)) %>%
  dplyr::select(a, b = b_display)

k2 <- kable(df2_short, "latex", booktabs = TRUE, row.names = FALSE, col.names = NULL,
            escape = TRUE) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped"), full_width = TRUE)

k2
```
